_description: Computer without a suitable GPU: the model runs in system memory on the CPU (gemma4:26b needs about 20 GB of free RAM; 32 GB installed or more). Much slower; a long timeout, and the model stays loaded for an hour between runs. Used by run_vlm_cpu.cmd. Same image sizes and frames as the GPU profile, so answers are comparable and the cache is shared.
_threads: num_threads null lets Ollama use the physical cores; set a number to leave cores free for other work.
